plugin.name: Skill center
page.title: Skills
page.desc: Reusable playbooks: the model reads them on demand, and you can call one directly with /skill-name
page.foot: The model only sees each skill's name and one-line description; the body is read on demand and never sits in context.
action.importTip: Import a skill (pick a directory containing SKILL.md or a .md file)
empty.title: No skills yet
empty.tail: . You can also import a directory directly.
row.toggleOff: Disable: removes it from the model catalog and deletes its command
row.toggleLocked: Provided by a plugin; cannot be toggled in the skill center
market.hint: One source per line: name, repository URL (a GitHub repo or index.json). Saving replaces the whole list.
market.installedTip: A skill with this name is already installed
market.noMatch: No skills in this source match "{query}".
market.empty: This source produced no skills. Check whether the address points to a GitHub repository or an index.json.
market.searchHint: skills.sh only supports search: type at least 2 characters.
market.searchReady: Type or edit a keyword (2+ characters) in the search box above to search.
market.softFailed: Could not fetch new results; showing the previous ones: {error}
toast.openFolderDesktopOnly: Opening with a system app only works in the desktop app (a browser has no such bridge)
toast.importDesktopOnly: Importing a skill uses the desktop shell's file picker, which a browser does not have
toast.installDesktopOnly: Installing a skill writes files under ~/.dsc/skills, which only the desktop app can do (a browser has no such bridge)
toast.sourceFormat: One source per line, formatted as: name, repository URL
toast.sourcesDesktopOnly: Changing market sources writes settings under ~/.dsc, which only the desktop app can do (a browser has no such bridge)
